title: Triage's outbox holds only notes whose finding lane has ended
why: Twice on Nov 8 (08:38 and 08:59 CST) triage held a live lane's notes in roadmap/outbox/triage.md. Under item 386 they ride in the lane that found them, and the coordinator had both pulled back. A note held away from its lane lands late, or twice.
note: Fix: the roadmap skill's outbox section says a note from a running lane goes back to that lane as a Fix: line or a follow-up PR; the outbox takes only notes whose lane has ended. Done check: the skill text names the rule. Filed by triage 09:02 CST Nov 8.
